title: SB 1114 (2015-2016 Regular Session, Michigan Legislature (bill page title: "Senate Bill 1114 of 2016")): Elections; absent voters; definition of absent voter; expand to include an elector who applies in person at the clerk's office and who presents photo identification. Amends secs. 758 & 759 of 1954 PA 116 (MCL 168.758 & 168.759).

(section) Sec. 758 (as in the version read)
(quote) (g) Applies for an absent voter ballot in person with the clerk of the township, city, or village in which he or she is registered, and he or she identifies himself or herself to the clerk by presenting an official state personal identification card issued to that elector under 1972 PA 222, MCL 28.291 to 28.300, an operator's or chauffeur's license issued to that elector under the Michigan vehicle code, 1949 PA 300, MCL 257.1 to 257.923, or another generally recognized picture identification card.
